analytics-tiempo-real.title: Real-Time Analytics System
analytics-tiempo-real.context: A B2B SaaS platform with 10k+ enterprise users needed to improve its reporting system
analytics-tiempo-real.problem: Users were waiting up to 5 minutes for updated reports, causing friction and feature abandonment
analytics-tiempo-real.role: Frontend Tech Lead — Backend coordination and client-side architecture design
analytics-tiempo-real.solution: Implemented a dashboard with real-time updates using WebSockets, query optimization and virtualization of large lists
analytics-tiempo-real.result: Load time reduced to <2s. Feature engagement grew 180%. Handles up to 100k datapoints without lag

checkout-redesign.title: Checkout Flow Redesign
checkout-redesign.context: Retail e-commerce with 68% cart abandonment during purchase
checkout-redesign.problem: Complex 7-step payment flow with slow validations and confusing mobile UX
checkout-redesign.role: Full Stack Developer — End-to-end development of the new flow
checkout-redesign.solution: Simplified to 3 steps, optimized async validations, session-based data persistence, mobile-first design and Stripe integration
checkout-redesign.result: Abandonment dropped to 32%. Conversion grew 45%. Avg purchase time went from 8min to 3min. +$2M extra annual revenue

monolito-microfrontends.title: Monolith to Microfrontends Migration
monolito-microfrontends.context: 5-year-old legacy app with a 200k+ line codebase that was hard to maintain
monolito-microfrontends.problem: Risky deploys, teams blocking each other, slow testing, new-dev onboarding of 3+ weeks
monolito-microfrontends.role: Senior Developer — Architecture and incremental migration
monolito-microfrontends.solution: Module Federation (Webpack 5) implementation, independent CI/CD per module, progressive migration with zero downtime
monolito-microfrontends.result: Deploy time from 2h to 15min. Feature velocity +60%. Onboarding reduced to 1 week. 0 critical incidents during migration
